results.title: Next.js 16 App Router route handler + Zod validation
results.summary: Validate JSON bodies and search params in a Next.js App Router route handler with Zod, returning typed 400s; tested by calling the handler with NextRequest.

results.title: Next.js App Router + Stripe webhook handler
results.summary: A Next.js route handler that verifies Stripe webhook signatures from the raw body and handles checkout.session.completed.

results.title: Next.js middleware + Supabase SSR session refresh
results.summary: Refresh Supabase auth cookies in Next.js middleware with @supabase/ssr and redirect signed-out users away from protected routes.

results.title: Vercel AI SDK tool loops, structured output and streaming with a mock model
results.summary: AI SDK generateText with a Zod-typed tool and a stopWhen step cap, Output.object structured results validated by Zod, and streamText deltas, all tested offline with MockLanguageModelV4 and simulateReadableStream from ai/test.

results.title: Next.js 16 server actions + Zod with useActionState-shaped results
results.summary: A 'use server' form action that validates FormData with Zod and returns field errors in the shape useActionState expects, tested by calling the action directly.

results.title: Anthropic SDK message streaming with text deltas, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream Claude responses with the Anthropic TypeScript SDK (messages.stream, text events, finalMessage), tested offline with a fake fetch returning Anthropic SSE events.

results.title: NextAuth.js v4 credentials provider + JWT/session callbacks (mocked)
results.summary: NextAuth v4 authOptions for Next.js with a Credentials provider, bcrypt-checked users and role claims flowing through jwt and session callbacks, unit-tested without a server.

results.title: requests-cache CachedSession with sqlite backend and expiry
results.summary: A requests session backed by a persistent sqlite cache with TTL expiry and 200-only caching, tested offline with responses mocks.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK streaming chat completions, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream chat completion deltas with the OpenAI SDK (for await over chunks), accumulate text and usage, and handle aborts, tested offline with a fake fetch that returns an SSE body.

results.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK tool use loop, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run a Claude tool_use loop with the official Anthropic SDK and Zod-validated tool inputs, tested offline with an injected fetch.
